declared_rule: Drifts e in {0, 1/4, 1/2, 1, 3} (declared validation drifts; guard_drift on [e-2h, e+2h], h = 1/10000). States: (0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(0,5/2),(5/2,0),(1/4,1/2),(1,1),(2,1),(1,3),(0,9/2),(9/2,0),(3/2,5/2). Test polynomials: w_const = 1; w_lin = p - 2m + 1; w_quad = p^2 + p m - m^2/2 + 3; w_cub = seeded random cubic (seed 11); w_bump = y (1 - (y/(5/2))^2)^4, y = m - 5/2. H1 on every (state, w, i in {0,1,2,3}, e). H2 triples (wF, wD, wH) in {(w_quad, w_lin, w_const), (w_cub, w_quad, w_lin), (w_bump, w_bump, w_bump), (w_cub, w_cub, w_cub)} on the grid {p, m in (0, 1/2, ..., 5)} intersected with the reachable closure. H3 on triples 1 and 3 at e in {1/4, 3}, box cover depth 4, z-panels of width 1/16. Fixed before the first run.
